exposure: Duration of the second stage of labour
cohort: The study included 3437 women who had a vaginal birth at "Mancha-Centro Hospital" (Spain) between 2013 and 2016.
finding: The risk of postpartum anaemia did not increase in nulliparous women when the second stage of labour exceeded 4 hours, but multiparous women with a second stage of labour beyond 3 hours had a higher risk of postpartum anaemia (OR = 2.43 [1.30-4.52]).
